sources.entry: Sage - Open-source agent harness with Desktop, Server and Python hosts, MCP tools, and task-feedback evaluation with user-selected version adoption; configured model providers may charge usage fees. #opensource #agents

summary.one_liner: Sage is an open-source agent harness (SAgents runtime) with Desktop, Server, and Python SDK hosts that improves agents through task feedback via recursive self-improvement (RSI), keeping every candidate version for user-selected adoption.
summary.what_it_does: Sage is a harness for building and running LLM agents, with a Python runtime called SAgents, a Flutter Desktop app, and a web Server with Agent Studio. Agents are defined as packages (instructions, Skills, tools, resources) in sage.yaml. The RSI workflow starts from a goal or curated usage history, generates candidate package versions, and retains each version with its diffs and evaluation records without activating them automatically. The harness supports sessions with persisted history, streaming output, pause/resume for human input and approvals, and tool policies and sandbox providers configured by the host. It composes native tools, Skills, and MCP services, and includes multi-agent workflows and replaceable model, memory, storage, and scheduling providers. The README also reports an exploratory tau-bench retail experiment comparing a baseline with an RSI candidate.
use_cases: Improve an agent's instructions and tools from task feedback
Run an AI agent on a desktop without writing code
Host a multi-user web agent platform
Embed a custom agent in a Python application
Connect MCP tool servers to an agent with authorization
Compare and choose between agent versions before adopting one
how_to_run: python -m pip install -e '.[desktop]' (from source; requires Python 3.12+ and Flutter)
cd app/v2/desktop && flutter pub get && flutter run -d macos
python -m pip install -e '.[server]' then cp .env.example app/v2/server/.env (requires MySQL and Node.js 22.12+)
cd app/v2/server/web && npm install && npm run build && cd ../../.. && python -m app.v2.server
Desktop installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux are available from release builds (see release notes)
Save the README's quickstart.py, set MODEL_API_KEY, and run python quickstart.py
notable: RSI workflow keeps each candidate and its evaluation evidence, and leaves adoption to the user rather than activating automatically
Three hosts share one SAgents runtime: Desktop app, web Server with Agent Studio, and Python SDK
Single-file Python SDK quickstart with no sage.yaml required
Desktop app bundles its Python backend in the installers
Includes an exploratory tau-bench retail measurement (baseline vs. RSI candidate) with paired-improvement and regression counts
caveats: Model providers may charge usage fees for the configured model service
Server supports only one worker; MySQL persistence does not enable horizontal scaling
Local process execution is not container isolation; built-in configs target a single process or host
Desktop RSI supports simple types and native tools only; general MCP integration does not imply RSI support
macOS packages are not notarized and Windows installers are not code-signed; Linux needs GTK and bubblewrap
Some component guides are only in Chinese; Sage Voice runs from source only on Apple Silicon macOS 15+
